homework.title: Heart Map
homework.subtitle: How well do you know each other's inner world? Three games, each followed by a short talk.
homework.description: In each step, answer separately and guess each other's answers. When the results open, talk through the questions below. There are no right or wrong answers; the point is to be curious and to listen.

steps.title: Everyday world
steps.description: Habits, preferences and the little things in a day.
talk: What is wearing you out the most in your days lately?
Which guess surprised you? Share the real answer.
What is your favourite moment of the day?

steps.title: Feelings and needs
steps.description: What you need in hard moments and how you talk about it.
talk: What helps you most when you're upset?
When do you feel most heard?
Is something on your mind lately?

steps.title: Values and dreams
steps.description: What matters most to you and what you hope for.
talk: Where did your rankings differ the most? Explain why you ordered it that way.
What do you most want to happen in the coming year?
What have you carried from childhood that still matters to you?
